Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a specialized cross-linking and purification method (VIR-CLASP) to enrich for RNA-binding proteins (RBPs). While not a standard PTM enrichment like phosphorylation, it is a targeted enrichment of a protein complex (RNA-protein). mod_ap_ms is the closest modifier for affinity-purification/complex-capture workflows.

scope: Crosslinked RNA-protein complexes were purified by Solid-Phase Reversible Immobilization (SPRI) beads (GE Healthcare, cat# 65152105050250) under denaturing SPRI buffer
Solid-phase capture of these complexes with SPRI beads under protein denaturing conditions leads to purification of total RNA but only proteins covalently crosslinked to the 4SU-labeled viral RNA.
The crosslinked RNA-protein complexes were eluted for 5min at 37 °C in denaturation buffer (lysis buffer).
